title: tools manifest
description: Source of truth for cells published by the tools plugin. Generated by the manifest-gen task from the artifacts/ tree + the created GitHub Release. Shipped inside the plugin clone at .tools/manifest.json so the BackendListVersions / BackendInstall hooks read it without a network round-trip to the Releases API.

release_tag.description: GitHub Release tag these assets are attached to, e.g. sandbox-20260710-81681a9.

base_url.description: Release download base: https://github.com/<owner>/mise-repo/releases/download/<release_tag>. asset_url = base_url + '/' + asset.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the manifest was regenerated.

default_buildgo.description: Clean build-go key applied when a golangci-lint version omits the -go<buildgo> suffix, e.g. 1.26.

cells.description: One entry per published (tool, version, buildgo, os, arch) cell. Skipped cells are omitted entirely.

tool.description: Tool-id within the plugin (the part after tools:).

version.description: Clean version key used as the semver-sortable selection root, e.g. 1.26, 1.27-beta, 2.1. Full suffix forms (1.26-darwin-arm64) are derived, not stored.

resolved_tag.description: Concrete upstream / built tag this cell was produced from. For go: the official upstream tag, e.g. go1.26.0, go1.27beta1. For golangci-lint: the pinned v2 tag it was built from, e.g. v2.1.0. Lets the plugin normalize 1.27-beta <-> go1.27beta<N>.

buildgo.description: Go toolchain that produced the asset. For tool=go this echoes the version row (e.g. 1.26). For golangci-lint it is the build-go row (e.g. 1.25, 1.26, 1.27-beta).

asset.description: Release asset filename, e.g. go1.26.0.linux-amd64.tar.gz or golangci-lint-2.1.0-go1.26.linux-amd64.tar.gz.

asset_url.description: Full asset download URL = base_url + '/' + asset. Redundant with base_url+asset but stored so a stale config.lua base cannot drift a cell.

sha256.description: sha256 of the Release asset. BackendInstall verifies the download against this before extracting.
